browser.J2.requests.reason: Deferring the ⌘K palette, Settings modal, Files and Links panes behind lazy chunks (6b495789, f8bad4b9, d240f450, 7114321d) cut J2 from 643 to 613 requests and session cold JS by ~49KB gzip; ff22caa1 then warms those chunks on idle inside J2's window, and the dev server serves them as separate modules, adding 40 (613 to 653). The extra requests are idle prefetches of code that otherwise loads on first open, not cold-path work. 08d952c0 and 48c0c628 added 2 earlier (641 to 643). The dev-only Agentation toolbar then left the page origin for localhost:4747, which the lab blocks, dropping one (653 to 652). Sharing one /api/events stream across tabs adds src/lib/shared-event-source.ts, which the dev server serves as its own module (652 to 653).

bundle.home.gzip.reason: Defer the Settings modal body (src/components/settings/settings-dialog.tsx with its tab sections, search and usage panels) behind src/components/settings/settings-dialog-entry.tsx until a #settings or #customize hash first opens it; the entry keeps the ⇧⌘, binding and useOpenSettings moves to open-settings.ts. Together with the deferred ⌘K palette, cold JS moves from 400471/1253321 (home) and 584921/1800169 (session) gzip/raw to the measured values; shared helpers now ship as small shared chunks, so the cold file count rises from 83 to 95 (home) and 102 to 119 (session). Other ceilings and the 1% tolerance are unchanged.
